title: Culdcept BEGINS on Steam 28 Oct (JST): first new Culdcept in about 10 years; $44.99; 3 new maps; Switch shipments past 100,000

claims.text: Steam release 28 Oct 2026 (Japan time; store shows 27 Oct)
$44.99 standard, Digital Deluxe $54.13, launch sale to 11 Nov
3 new battle maps, 10 book covers, UI fixes; same to Switch as a free update
First new entry in about 10 years

media.kind: the game's own trailer, music only, from 23.5 s; text cards and speech bubbles left out

notes: Grammar review: no required edits after ألعاب اللوح became الألعاب اللوحية (DeepL forward: لعبة لوحية). DeepL back-check matches. Final render was blocked by disk at 06:52Z; rendered at 08:12Z after clearing ReVamp's cache.
